````markdown
This article provides the timestamps for each section of the post-game screen. Post-game refers to all screens that appear after the match is complete.

---
# ==Team Gamemodes==

| Section | Start | End |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| ==**Default**== | -- | -- |
| ==Match Complete Text== | 0s | 3.25s |
| ==Victory Pose== | 3.25s | 8.5s |
| ==Play of the Game== | 8.5s | 26s |
| ==**Elimination**== | -- | -- |
| ==Duel Results== | 26s | 33s |

# ==Free-for-All (FFA) Gamemodes==

| Section | Start | End |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| ==Match Complete Text== | 0s | 3.25s |
| ==Play of the Game== | 3.25s | 20.5s |
| ==Victory Pose and Scoreboard== | 20.5s | 30.5s |
````
